keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Universitatea Craiova 1, Egnatia Rrogozhinë 0. Alexandru Cicâldau (Universitatea Craiova) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner.
Goal! Universitatea Craiova 2, Egnatia Rrogozhinë 0. Nicusor Bancu (Universitatea Craiova) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Carlos Mora.
Nikola Stevanovic (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Universitatea Craiova 2, Egnatia Rrogozhinë 0.
Second Half begins Universitatea Craiova 2, Egnatia Rrogozhinë 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Eneo Bitri (Egnatia Rrogozhinë).

Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Simon Elisor replaces Assad Al Hamlawi.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Alexandru Cicâldau (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. David Matei replaces Alexandru Cicâldau.
Eneo Bitri (Egnatia Rrogozhinë) is shown the yellow card.
Simon Elisor (Universitatea Craiova) is shown the yellow card.
Second yellow card to Eneo Bitri (Egnatia Rrogozhinë) for a bad foul.
Substitution, Universitatea Craiova. Adrian Rus replaces Nikola Stevanovic.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
